repos_data.description: Open-source ADE for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and more. Put several coding agents in one thread, with pull requests, a browser and Git beside the chat.

A small, free, open-source Mac and Windows app for talking to your AI agents, WhatsApp-style: OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and any ACP agent, on every machine, are contacts with their own chats, and a little guy in the menu bar (or taskbar) shows who needs you.
An open-source cursor alternative, supporting local and frontier harnesses, built on VS Code.

Stop burning your Claude or Codex limits on boilerplate. Delegate multi-file implementation to Cursor's Composer 2.5 over MCP — your frontier model writes the brief and reviews the diff; Composer does the typing, fast, on a separate quota.

Free, open-source desktop app for Claude Code and Codex: follow every agent and subagent live, run your own agent organization and automate routines. Also searches your Gemini CLI and Grok history. macOS, Windows, Linux.
